vat_rates.legal_product_description: Standard rate of Value Added Tax, calculated by multiplying the value of the taxable supply or import by the value added tax rate.
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of value added tax on taxable supplies and taxable imports
vat_rates.rate_basis: value of the supply or import
vat_rates.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2014 (Act No. 5 of 2014), Section 5(1)

vat_zero_rated.rate_basis: non applicable à l'importation — régime des exportations
vat_zero_rated.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2014 (Act No. 5 of 2014), Section 5(2) and Section 55 — exportations au taux zéro
vat_zero_rated.notes: documentation seule — le zéro-rated exportations dépend de la nature de l'opération, pas du code SH : jamais appliqué automatiquement aux lignes d'import
